name: Mitrefinch (now part of OneAdvanced)
description_en:
Mitrefinch is now part of OneAdvanced, whose official acquisition page directs buyers to its current Time and Attendance and Payroll products. This record preserves the historical catalog slug while describing that verified transition and the present workforce-product route, rather than attributing OneAdvanced’s entire portfolio to the old brand.

The current offering emphasizes time capture, rostering, absence, employee self-service and payroll linkage. Existing Mitrefinch customers should confirm their supported product, deployment and upgrade path: the acquisition page alone does not prove feature parity or automatic migration of a legacy installation.
description_zh:
Mitrefinch 现属于 OneAdvanced，后者官方收购页引导买家了解当前 Time and Attendance 与 Payroll 产品。本档案保留历史目录 slug，说明已核实的品牌转变及现行人员产品入口，不把 OneAdvanced 全部产品归给旧品牌。

现行产品重点为工时采集、排班、缺勤、员工自助及工资联动。既有 Mitrefinch 客户需确认所用产品、部署和升级路径，收购页面本身不能证明旧安装功能完全一致或会自动迁移。

core_features.name_zh: 工时采集与工时表审批
core_features.explanation_en: Current Time and Attendance supports hardware, mobile and desktop capture, anomaly alerts and approved-timesheet payroll export.
core_features.explanation_zh: 当前 Time and Attendance 支持硬件、移动端、桌面采集、异常提醒及已批准工时表导出至工资。

core_features.explanation_en: Rules-based schedules consider skills and preferences, while employees request leave and swap shifts through self-service.
core_features.explanation_zh: 按规则排班考虑技能和偏好，员工通过自助申请休假及换班。

core_features.explanation_en: The current Payroll product describes UK pay documents, RTI, pensions and imported attendance, rather than being assumed included with attendance.
core_features.explanation_zh: 当前 Payroll 描述英国工资文档、RTI、养老金及考勤导入，不能假定已含在考勤产品中。

pricing.summary_en: Current OneAdvanced workforce products require quote; software, hardware, implementation and legacy transition terms were not priced.
pricing.summary_zh: 现行 OneAdvanced 人员产品需报价，软件、硬件、实施及旧系统过渡条件尚未核实金额。

sections.title_en: Use the current vendor route without assuming a migration
sections.title_zh: 使用现行供应商入口并单独确认迁移
sections.en: The official OneAdvanced page explicitly says Mitrefinch has joined OneAdvanced and presents Time and Attendance and Payroll as the relevant solutions. The original mitrefinch.com address failed certificate hostname validation during this research; TLS validation was not disabled. The current vendor page provides a legitimate identity route, but does not establish which legacy Mitrefinch version maps to each current cloud capability. Existing users should state their version, hosting and hardware when asking about renewal or replacement. New buyers should evaluate the named current products rather than an undifferentiated historical HR suite.
sections.zh: OneAdvanced 官方页面明确说明 Mitrefinch 已加入，并展示相关 Time and Attendance 与 Payroll 方案。本研究访问原 mitrefinch.com 地址时证书主机名校验失败，未关闭 TLS 校验。当前供应商页提供合法身份线索，但未确立各旧版本与现行云功能的映射。既有用户询问续订或替换时应提供版本、托管方式和硬件；新买家则应评估现行具名产品，而非笼统的历史 HR 套件。

sections.title_en: Trace a shift from roster to approved hours
sections.title_zh: 从排班追踪到批准工时
sections.en: Current Time and Attendance describes rules-based rostering, skills and preferences, leave, shift swaps and flexible clocking through hardware, mobile or desktop. Anomalies can generate alerts, and managers approve timesheets before payroll export. A practical demonstration should follow an overnight shift, an absent worker and a replacement, then compare scheduled time, captured events, approved hours and pay-rule output. This is a proposed test, not an executed workflow. Confirm the exact clock model, offline behavior, amendment permissions and integration mapping rather than assuming any historic Mitrefinch device works unchanged.
sections.zh: 当前 Time and Attendance 描述按规则排班、技能偏好、休假、换班及通过硬件、移动端或桌面打卡。异常可提醒，由经理批准工时表后导出至工资。演示可跟踪夜班、缺勤人员及替班，再比较计划时间、采集事件、批准工时和工资规则输出。这是拟议测试，并非已执行流程。需确认具体打卡器型号、离线行为、更正权限及集成映射，不能假定历史 Mitrefinch 设备无需调整即可兼容。

sections.title_en: Keep UK payroll and country availability explicit
sections.title_zh: 明确英国工资与国家可用性
sections.en: The linked Payroll page describes gross-to-net calculations, pay frequencies, P60 and P11D documents, pension auto-enrolment and RTI submissions to HMRC. It also offers on-demand pay through Wagestream, a separate service relationship to confirm. These UK-oriented capabilities do not establish equivalent payroll filings in every country. The attendance FAQ itself tells buyers to contact sales about regional availability. Current pages list MFA, SSO and role-based controls, but these were not configured or independently inspected. Require separate software entitlements and supported attendance-to-payroll data flow in the proposal.
sections.zh: 所链接 Payroll 页面描述税前到实发、发薪频率、P60 和 P11D、养老金自动登记及向 HMRC 提交 RTI，还提供通过 Wagestream 提前支取工资，需确认该独立服务关系。这些英国导向能力不能证明每国有等同申报。考勤 FAQ 本身要求向销售确认地区可用性。现行页面列出 MFA、SSO 和角色控制，但未配置或独立检查；应在方案中分别明确软件权益及受支持的考勤到工资数据流。

sections.title_en: Quote cloud products, hardware and transition work
sections.title_zh: 询价云产品、硬件及过渡工作
sections.en: The official pages offer demos and a sales callback, without a numeric rate, billing basis, minimum term or implementation schedule. Ask for attendance, payroll, clocks, identity services, migration, training and support as explicit items, and identify any legacy maintenance or upgrade obligation. No free full plan or open-source license was established. The current Time and Attendance is described as cloud software; that is not a statement that every old deployment has already moved. Hosting location, complete exports, correction history, recovery, old-to-new compatibility and signed service terms remain unverified. No account, clock or payroll transaction was tested.
sections.zh: 官方页面提供演示及销售回电，没有金额、计费依据、最短期限或实施时间表。应分别询价考勤、工资、打卡器、身份服务、迁移、培训和支持，并明确旧维护或升级义务。本研究未确立完整免费套餐或开源许可。现行 Time and Attendance 描述为云软件，不代表所有旧部署已迁往云端。托管地点、完整导出、更正历史、恢复、新旧兼容及签署服务条款仍未核实，未测试账户、设备或工资交易。
